name: Spin 640 Plus
summary: Fully automatic, random-access clinical chemistry analyzer running 400 photometric tests per hour, up to 640 with the optional ISE module. 90 onboard samples, a refrigerated 80-position reagent tray, 12 wavelengths, automatic dilution, an optional internal barcode reader and a bi-directional LIS interface.

specs.label: Type
specs.value: Fully automatic, random access, STAT sample priority

specs.label: Throughput
specs.value: 400 tests/hour, up to 640 tests/hour with ISE

specs.label: Methods
specs.value: End point, fixed time, kinetic; optional ISE; single, dual, triple and quadruple reagent chemistries; monochromatic or bichromatic

specs.label: Sample tray
specs.value: 90 positions for primary or secondary tubes and sample cups

specs.label: Sample probe
specs.value: Liquid level detection, clot detection, vertical and horizontal collision protection

specs.label: Probe cleaning
specs.value: Automatic inside and outside washing, carryover ≤ 0.1%

specs.label: Automatic dilution
specs.value: Pre- and post-dilution up to 1:150, in a cuvette

specs.label: Reagent tray
specs.value: 80 positions refrigerated at 4 – 10 °C (77 reagents + 4 ISE electrodes)

specs.label: Reagent probes
specs.value: 2 independent probes with liquid level detection, collision protection and inventory checking; automatic inside and outside washing

specs.label: Reaction rotor
specs.value: 90 cuvettes on a rotating tray, 8-step automatic washing

specs.label: ISE module
specs.value: Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻ or Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻, Li⁺; up to 320 tests/hour

specs.label: Internal barcode reader
specs.value: Sample and reagent ID; Codabar, ITF, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, UPC/EAN

specs.label: Calibration modes
specs.value: Linear (one-point, two-point, multipoint), Logit-Log 4P, Logit-Log 5P, spline, exponential, polynomial, parabola

specs.label: Control rules
specs.value: Westgard multi-rule, cumulative sum check, twin plot

specs.label: Operating system
specs.value: Windows XP Professional/Home SP2, Windows Vista Home/Business

features: 400 tests per hour, up to 640 with the optional ISE module
Fully automatic random access with STAT sample priority
Refrigerated reagent tray: 77 positions + 4 ISE electrodes
Automatic probe cleaning with liquid level detection
Automatic dilution of abnormal samples, up to 1:150
